title: China Eases Pressure on Private Teaching Companies
titleZh: 中国缓解对民营培训机构的压力
credits: Casey Hall, Laurie Chen reported from Beijing, with additional reporting by Ellen Zhang from Shanghai for Reuters News Agency. Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: China is quietly easing regulations on private education companies as the government aims to support a slowing economy.
sentences.zh: 中国正悄然放宽对私立教育公司的监管，政府旨在支持放缓的经济。

sentences.en: Government officials have not announced a policy change.
sentences.zh: 政府官员尚未宣布政策发生变化。

sentences.en: But news reports say policymakers are now permitting the tutoring industry to grow.
sentences.zh: 但新闻报道称，决策者如今已允许补习行业成长。

sentences.en: Industry experts say the new efforts aim to support job creation.
sentences.zh: 行业专家表示，这些新举措旨在支持就业创造。

sentences.en: Reuters News Agency recently spoke with people in the industry, parents in China and others.
sentences.zh: 路透社通讯社近日采访了行业内人士、中国的父母以及其他人士。

sentences.en: Here is what Reuters reported:
sentences.zh: 以下是路透社的报道内容：

sentences.en: Starting in 2021, the government prohibited for-profit tutoring in main school subjects such as math and English.
sentences.zh: 自2021年起，政府禁止了数学和英语等主要学科中的营利性补习。

sentences.en: The reported aim was to reduce financial pressure on families.
sentences.zh: 据报道，此举旨在减轻家庭的经济压力。

sentences.en: It was also meant to create equal educational chances for both rich and poor families and to eliminate poor quality tutoring services.
sentences.zh: 其目的还在于为富人和穷人家创造平等的教育机会，并消除低质量的补习服务。

sentences.en: The policy was known as the “double reduction.”
sentences.zh: 这项政策被称为“双减”。

sentences.en: The crackdown cost the industry billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 此次整顿使该行业损失了数十亿美元。

sentences.en: It affected companies like New Oriental Education & Technology Group and TAL Education Group.
sentences.zh: 它影响了新东方教育科技集团和好未来教育集团等公司。

sentences.en: It also led to tens of thousands of job losses.
sentences.zh: 它还导致了数万个工作岗位的流失。

sentences.en: Before the policy change, China's for-profit tutoring industry was valued at about $100 billion.
sentences.zh: 在政策发生变化之前，中国的营利性补习行业估值约为1000亿美元。

sentences.en: The three biggest companies employed over 170,000 people.
sentences.zh: 这三家最大的公司雇佣了超过17万人。

sentences.en: During the crackdown, the industry did not disappear as parents continued to seek tutoring services for their children.
sentences.zh: 在整顿期间，随着父母继续为孩子寻求补习服务，该行业并未消失。

sentences.en: Many Chinese parents consider after-school tutoring services as a way for their children to gain an advantage in China’s competitive education system.
sentences.zh: 许多中国父母将课后补习服务视为孩子在中国竞争激烈的教育体系中获取优势的一种方式。

sentences.en: Michelle Lee is a parent based in southern China.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·李是位居住在中国南部的父母。

sentences.en: Lee spends about $420 a month on after-school classes for her son and daughter.
sentences.zh: 李每月在儿子的课后班上花费约420美元。

sentences.en: These classes include mathematics tutoring and online lessons in English.
sentences.zh: 这些课程包括数学补习和英语在线课程。

sentences.en: She told Reuters that in recent months tutoring schools had been operating more openly.
sentences.zh: 她告诉路透社，近几个月来，培训机构更加公开地运营。

sentences.en: After the government crackdown in 2021, the number of tutoring centers and the number of teachers employed by them fell.
sentences.zh: 在2021年政府打击之后，培训中心数量和它们雇佣的教师数量都下降了。

sentences.en: The industry is now coming back as policies ease.
sentences.zh: 如今，随着政策放宽，该行业正在复苏。

sentences.en: The research company Plenum China said that active licenses for for-profit tutoring centers rose 11.4 percent between January and June.
sentences.zh: 研究公司普伦姆中国表示，1月至6月间，营利性培训中心的活跃许可证数量增长了11.4%。

sentences.en: Liu Xiya is a delegate to China's legislature and president of an education group based in the southwestern city of Chongqing.
sentences.zh: 刘喜亚是中国立法机构代表，也是位于西南城市重庆的一所教育集团的总裁。

sentences.en: Liu told local media at a press conference in March that the government was dealing with problems in education policy.
sentences.zh: 刘喜亚在3月的一次新闻发布会上对当地媒体表示，政府正在处理教育政策中的问题。

sentences.en: Lynn Song is an economist at ING.
sentences.zh: 宋琳是荷兰国际集团的经济学家。

sentences.en: He said China was unlikely to admit that the crackdown "was a little too forceful" but that regulations would be loosened.
sentences.zh: 他表示，中国不太可能承认这场打击“有点过于强硬”，但监管将会放宽。

sentences.en: He said, "The overall policy environment has changed from restrictive to supportive as the main goal now is stabilization.”
sentences.zh: 他说：“总体政策环境已从限制性转向支持性，因为当前的主要目标是稳定。”

sentences.en: Two business leaders who deal with government regulations at large tutoring companies recently spoke with Reuters.
sentences.zh: 两位经常与政府打交道的大型培训公司的企业负责人近日接受了路透社的采访。

sentences.en: They said government moves to ease the crackdown had sped up in recent months.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，政府放宽打击力度的举措在近几个月有所加快。

sentences.en: They noted a decision in August by the State Council, China's cabinet, to include education services in a 20-point plan to increase spending.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到，8月国务院，即中国内阁，作出决定，将教育服务纳入一份增加支出的20点计划。

sentences.en: This policy goal comes as more than 11 million university graduates entered China's employment market.
sentences.zh: 这一政策目标出现之时，超过1100万大学毕业生进入了中国的就业市场。

sentences.en: It also appeared to increase the stock value of publicly traded education companies.
sentences.zh: 此举似乎还提升了上市教育公司的股价。

sentences.en: The decision in August followed guidelines from China's education ministry in February.
sentences.zh: 8月的决定紧随2月中国教育部发布的指导意见。

sentences.en: These guidelines explained what kinds of after-school tutoring would now be permitted.
sentences.zh: 这些指导意见解释了如今哪些类型的课后辅导将被允许。

sentences.en: Last year, the ministry published online a list of companies approved to provide tutoring in subjects that were not considered basic, or core subjects.
sentences.zh: 去年，该部在网上公布了一份获准提供非基础学科或核心学科辅导的公司名单。

sentences.en: To get around the rules, tutoring centers would often rename classes.
sentences.zh: 为了规避规则，培训中心常常给课程改名。

sentences.en: For example, math classes were commonly called “logical thinking” classes.
sentences.zh: 例如，数学课通常被称为“逻辑思维”课。

sentences.en: A woman who ran an English tutoring school in the eastern province of Zhejiang said she laid off 60 percent of her workers following the crackdown.
sentences.zh: 一位在东部省份浙江经营英语培训学校的妇女表示，在打击之后，她裁掉了60%的员工。

sentences.en: Lisa did not want to give her full name to Reuters.
sentences.zh: Lisa不愿向路透透露她的全名。

sentences.en: But she said the school continued to teach science-related courses in English, without calling them English classes.
sentences.zh: 但她表示，学校仍在用英语讲授与科学相关的课程，只是不称其为英语课。

sentences.en: Also, one-on-one tutoring did very well during the crackdown.
sentences.zh: 此外，在整顿期间，一对一辅导生意兴隆。

sentences.en: Parents who could afford it paid for tutors to come to their homes.
sentences.zh: 负担得起的家长花钱请老师到家里辅导孩子。

sentences.en: Some parents said this increases an academic gap, where students from rich families do better in school than poor families.
sentences.zh: 有的家长说，这加剧了学业差距，即富裕家庭的学生比贫困家庭的学生在校表现更好。

sentences.en: That worries parents like Yang Zengdong, a Shanghai-based mother of two.
sentences.zh: 这让像常驻上海的两位孩子的母亲杨曾栋这样的家长感到担忧。

sentences.en: She said the policy presented families with the hard choice: either pay up to $112 per class for a private tutor or spend hours each day teaching the children themselves.
sentences.zh: 她说，这项政策让家庭面临两难选择：要么每节课花112美元请私人老师，要么每天花几个小时亲自教孩子。

sentences.en: She said that if this continues, "…the academic gap between rich people and everyone else will get worse.”
sentences.zh: 她说，如果这种情况持续下去，"……富人与其他人之间的学业差距将会扩大。"

sentences.en: Yang said, "That wasn't what the policy was meant to do, but that's the reality, so of course it needs to change."
sentences.zh: 杨说，"这并非政策本意，但现实如此，所以当然需要改变。"

sentences.en: And I’m Mario Ritter Jr.
sentences.zh: 我是马里奥·里特。

glossary.def: for a student to receive additional teacher from a qualified person in addition to their normal schooling usually to help them with a subject they are having difficulty with
glossary.zh: tutoring	课外辅导；一对一辅导

glossary.def: something that is not permitted or is barred by law
glossary.zh: prohibited	被禁止的；明令禁止的

glossary.def: to remove, take a way or end
a government campaign against something aiming to change behavior or stop an activity or movement
glossary.zh: crackdown	严厉镇压；严加管制

glossary.def: something that helps a person or group in a situation where they are being judged competitively
an official document giving a person or group permission to do business, operate equipment or do some activity that is overseen by a local or national government
the process of limiting changes and bringing things to a normal state
to be able to pay for or endure something
an imbalance that exists in something related to schooling
glossary.zh: academic gap	学业差距；学习差距
